per_step.command: echo "Experimental deltas:"; for f in /app/data/neurocure_2024/participant_*.json; do delta=$(jq '.post_treatment_score - .baseline_cognition_score' "$f"); group=$(jq -r '.treatment_group' "$f"); if [ "$group" = "experimental" ]; then echo $delta; fi; done; echo -e "\nControl deltas:"; for f in /app/data/neurocure_2024/participant_*.json; do delta=$(jq '.post_treatment_score - .baseline_cognition_score' "$f"); group=$(jq -r '.treatment_group' "$f"); if [ "$group" = "control" ]; then echo $delta; fi; done

python3 -c "import sys, json, numpy as np, scipy.stats as stats; data_dir='/app/data/neurocure_2024/'; exp_deltas=[]; ctrl_deltas=[]; import glob, os; for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(data_dir, 'participant_*.json')): with open(f) as fd: d=json.load(fd); delta=d['post_treatment_score']-d['baseline_cognition_score']; if d['treatment_group']=='experimental': exp_deltas.append(delta); else: ctrl_deltas.append(delta); print('Exp deltas:', exp_deltas); print('Ctrl deltas:', ctrl_deltas); t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(exp_deltas, ctrl_deltas); print('t-stat:', t_stat, 'p-value:', p_val); cohens_d = (np.mean(exp_deltas) - np.mean(ctrl_deltas)) / np.sqrt((np.std(exp_deltas, ddof=1)**2 + np.std(ctrl_deltas, ddof=1)**2)/2); print('Cohen\\'s d:', cohens_d)"
